title: How do we describe the pathway when it differs between clinics?

posts.text: In Greifswald the pathway is not the same in the two clinics that treat our patients. Should we draw one map or two?
We had the same question. We drew one map and marked the differences in another colour. It was easier to discuss.
Thank you. We will do the same and make a joint map with Rostock. @Astrid Vestergaard is that acceptable for the WP2 report?

title: Referral pathway: results from the first two weeks

posts.text: We received 14 referrals in two weeks. Oncologists say the named receiver makes the difference. Two referrals were for patients who were too ill to exercise.
Very useful. In Gdańsk the named person also checks the clinic list. The two ideas could work together.
@Linnea Sjöhage could you share how physiotherapists in Ängelholm answer a referral? We need a short reply text.

title: Digital consultations: how much time do you allow?

posts.text: How long is a digital consultation in your clinic, including preparation and notes? We plan for 45 minutes.
30 minutes with the patient and 10 minutes for notes. The first session takes longer because of technical problems.
In Rostock we book 60 minutes for the first session and 30 minutes for the following sessions.
The proposed schedule is in the document library. The first session is on 8 February. Please tell us before 26 November if the dates do not work in your country.
The week of 14 February is a school holiday in parts of Poland. Could we move session 2 by one week?

title: Materiały dla pacjentów po polsku (patient material in Polish)

posts.text:
Czy ktoś ma już przetłumaczoną instrukcję do aplikacji? Chcemy uniknąć podwójnej pracy.

Short summary in English: we ask if anyone already has a Polish translation of the app instruction.

Mamy wersję roboczą ze Szczecina. Prześlę ją do biblioteki dokumentów.

Short summary in English: Szczecin has a draft and will add it to the document library.

title: Does anyone have a consent text for video exercise sessions?

posts.text: We would like to start group exercise by video in our municipal centre. Does anyone have a short consent text for patients that we could adapt?
We have a general text that explains what is recorded and what is not. I can share it. Please check it with your own data protection officer.

title: Which tablets work well for home exercise for older patients?

posts.text: Several of our patients are over 75 and do not own a smartphone. Which tablets have you lent to patients, and what was easy or difficult for them?
